test_order_by_basic: test ORDER BY with DISTINCT, GROUP BY, and aggregate expressions on scanned IPC data
test_order_by_misc_selection: test ORDER BY with aliased columns, wildcards, expressions, NULLS FIRST/LAST, and ORDER BY ALL
